title: Pretty much a cash grab
body: It’s not usable unless you pay $4 a month (or $35 forever). I mean, the dev acts like there’s a free version, but allowing only TWO habits and recurring tasks, it’s really more a proof of concept than an app. While you can have unlimited non-recurring tasks, you really might as well use iOS’ Notes at that point. Heck, even iOS’ Reminders lets you have unlimited recurring tasks. I’m really not sure about the value proposition of an app that asks you to pay to barely edge out the utility of an inbuilt app.
